使用任何视频中的动作制作角色图像动画

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤1.上传您的角色图片。您想要制作动画的角色的清晰全身或中景参考。 SCAIL 在整个剪辑中保持脸部、服装和颜色的稳定。适用于：插图·3D 渲染·照片·AI 角色

步骤 2. 上传您的驾驶视频。您想要复制的动作，例如舞蹈、散步或打斗序列。工作流程逐帧读取姿势骨架。

步骤3.添加样式提示。外观和背景的简短台词，例如“电影工作室镜头，柔和的灯光”。

步骤 4. 点击运行并下载。 SCAIL 将动作映射到角色上并生成剪辑。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。准备就绪：Premiere · CapCut · DaVinci Resolve · 任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。位姿检测器、SCAIL 模型和速度 LoRA 已连接。带上干净的角色图像和清晰的驾驶视频，让默认运行。

概述

此工作流程使用 Wan 2.1 和 SCAIL 对角色图像进行动画处理。 SCAIL 是一种基于 Wan 2.1 图像到视频主干网络构建的姿势引导动画模型。它需要三个输入：您的角色图像、带有您想要的动作的驾驶视频以及简短的提示。姿势检测器从驾驶视频中提取骨架，SCAIL 将其转换为尊重深度和遮挡的 3D 感知姿势图。 CLIP 对您的角色进行编码，因此脸部、服装和颜色可以贯穿整个序列。然后，Wan 2.1 生成帧。较旧的姿势系统会折断四肢并在快速运动时失去跟踪。 SCAIL 的 3D 姿势处理解决了这个问题，这就是为什么它可以遵循复杂的运动和快速缩放而不会摔倒 分开。

适用对象：创作者、VTuber 和动画团队，希望在 ComfyUI 中实现姿势驱动的角色动画，而无需从头开始连接姿势检测器和 SCAIL 节点。不适用于：快速的一键式剪辑。你需要一个干净的角色形象和一个好的驾驶视频，跑步大约需要八分钟。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的角色图像和带有您想要的动作的驾驶视频。

  2. 添加简短的提示符，然后运行。

  3. 下载动画剪辑，为任何编辑者做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。这个比大多数都重：每个剪辑大约需要八分钟，因为工作流程提取完整的姿势序列，然后生成每一帧。需要了解的两个限制：SCAIL 是预览模型，因此每次运行的结果都会有所不同，并且您的驾驶视频决定了大部分结果。源中的遮挡、人群和严重的运动模糊在动画中显示为伪影。

使用案例

短片和社交。将真实视频中的舞蹈或流行动作映射到您自己的角色或头像上。

VTuber 和角色艺术家。在设计保持不变的情况下，将单个插图变成动画表演。

游戏和动画。无需构建 3D 装备即可制作过场动画、编排或分块原型。

广告和品牌。使用真实的拍摄动作让吉祥物或角色栩栩如生。

Wan 2.1 和 SCAIL 可以制作什么动画？

o.en:
Animate a character image with motion from any video

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your character image. A clean full-body or mid-shot reference of the character you want to animate. SCAIL holds the face, outfit, and colors steady across the whole clip. Works great with: illustrations · 3D renders · photos · AI characters

Step 2. Upload your driving video. The motion you want to copy, like a dance, a walk, or a fight sequence. The workflow reads the pose skeleton out of it frame by frame.

Step 3. Add a style prompt. A short line for the look and context, like "cinematic studio footage, soft lighting."

Step 4. Hit run and download. SCAIL maps the motion onto your character and generates the clip. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Premiere · CapCut · DaVinci Resolve · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The pose detectors, the SCAIL model, and the speed LoRA are already wired. Bring a clean character image and a clear driving video, and let the defaults run.

Overview

This workflow animates a character image using Wan 2.1 and SCAIL. SCAIL is a pose-guided animation model built on the Wan 2.1 image-to-video backbone. It takes three inputs: your character image, a driving video with the motion you want, and a short style prompt. A pose detector pulls the skeleton out of the driving video, and SCAIL converts it into a 3D-aware pose map that respects depth and occlusion. CLIP encodes your character, so the face, outfit, and colors hold across the sequence. Wan 2.1 then generates the frames. Older pose systems break limbs and lose tracking on fast movement. SCAIL's 3D pose handling is what fixes that, which is why it follows complex motion and quick zooms without falling apart.

Who it's for: creators, VTubers, and animation teams who want pose-driven character animation in ComfyUI without wiring the pose detectors and SCAIL nodes from scratch. Not for: a fast one-click clip. You need a clean character image and a good driving video, and a run takes about eight minutes.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your character image and the driving video with the motion you want.

  2. Add a short style prompt, then run.

  3. Download the animated clip, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. This one is heavier than most: each clip takes about eight minutes, because the workflow extracts the full pose sequence and then generates every frame. Two limits to know: SCAIL is a preview model, so results vary between runs, and your driving video decides most of the outcome. Occlusions, crowds, and heavy motion blur in the source show up as artifacts in the animation.

Use Cases

Short-form & Social. Map a dance or a trending motion from a real video onto your own character or avatar.

VTubers & Character Artists. Turn a single illustration into an animated performance while the design holds.

Games & Animation. Prototype cutscenes, choreography, or blocking without building a 3D rig.

Ads & Branding. Bring a mascot or a character to life using real, filmed motion.
